tagline.zh: 关系和时间，放在同一个数据库里。
tagline.en: Relationships and time, in one database.

summary.zh: 一个开源的图数据库。关系，以及每条记录随时间的变化，放在同一个地方。
summary.en: An open-source graph database. Relationships, and how each record changes over time, in one place.

notice.zh: 能跑，能评估，还不建议直接上生产。
notice.en: Runs, and is ready to evaluate. Not yet for production.

text.zh: 从一个对象出发，沿着连接找到相关的记录，不用先写一堆 JOIN。
text.en: Start from one object and walk the connections to related records, without writing a wall of joins first.

text.zh: 对象的历史值跟着对象走。查价格、查温度，不用另搭一套时序库。
text.en: History travels with the object it belongs to. Prices or temperatures, without a second time-series database.

text.zh: 一个二进制文件起服务，没有外部依赖，本地也能跑起来看效果。
text.en: One binary starts the service, with no external dependencies, so you can run it locally and look at real output.

text.zh: Apache 2.0。代码和设计上的取舍都写在仓库里，包括做错的部分。
text.en: Apache 2.0. The code and the trade-offs behind it are in the repository, including the ones that did not work.
